kaikki_vikisozluk.e: ناقِلُ الْكُفْرِ لَيْسَ بِكافِرٍ • (nāqilu l-kufri laysa bikāfirin)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally: “He who informs about disbelief is not [thereby] a disbeliever”.
g: Used to indicate that one informs about or quotes a heretical opinion, in order to avoid the imputation that merely mentioning it is already a form of acquiescence to it.
Used to distance oneself from something one informs about or quotes; don't shoot the messenger.
